biggest_catch: The friend must present the program at account opening, and rewards stack across product types up to $200 per membership.
catches: Referral reward applies to both the referring member and the new member: $25 new youth account; $50 active checking; $75 active credit card; $100 auto/rec vehicle loan.
A bonus of up to $200 could be deposited to each membership's account when all requirements are met (stacking across product types).
One new member offer per product type per social security number.

Qualifications within 90 days of account opening: youth account needs AFT from parent/guardian; checking needs $1,000+/month DD and eStatements/eNotices/eAlerts; credit card needs 10 purchases; auto/rec loan over $10,000 with first payment made (indirect loans excluded).
Referrer must be an existing NCACU member; referred must not be a current member or have been one in the past 12 months.
Both must have a valid US taxpayer identification number; bonus reported as dividends on IRS form 1099-INT.
Referral bonus paid approximately 90 days from new membership opening.
Offer applies to consumer accounts only; may be modified or canceled at any time; available for a limited time only.
Tax treatment stated: reported as dividends on 1099-INT; taxes are the recipient's responsibility.

steps: Share NCACU's refer-a-friend program with a friend (they must present the program at account opening).
Friend joins NCACU and opens an account within 90-day qualification window.
Friend meets product qualifications (youth AFT, $1,000/month DD checking, 10-purchase credit card, or $10,000+ auto/rec loan with first payment).
You and your friend each receive $25-$100 per product type (up to $200 per membership), paid approximately 90 days after membership opening.
timing: Bonus paid approximately 90 days from new membership opening.
when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: Bonus paid approximately 90 days from new membership opening. — structural: a 90-day account-open/seasoning requirement must elapse before payout.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
The 90-day seasoning/hold is structural — pick a different referral program if you need money sooner.
